business.name: Roam Coffee
business.story: Roam Coffee started as a dream over six years ago in Central Coast California. Now serving the Durham Region, we strive to bring the excellence and culture of Californian third-wave coffee to our beautiful Ontario home. We are dedicated to coffee quality and sustainability, partnering with some of the best Canadian roasters and producers to bring you a local and environmentally-conscious cup.
business.address: 62 King St. West, Bowmanville, ON L1C 1R4
business.location_note: Located inside Markets Ontario, shares space with Nest Specialty Desserts.

hours.note: Google Business Profile lists slightly different hours (Mon closed, Tue-Sat 8:30a-5p, Sun 10a-3p per one listing; Markets Ontario page lists Mon-Thu 7:30a-5p, Fri 7:30a-7p, Sat 8:30a-7p, Sun 8:30a-5p). Hours conflict across sources -- confirm actual current hours with client before publishing.

content_gaps: Website 'Menu' page lists Espresso, Macchiato, Cortado, Cappuccino, Latte, Brew, Americano, Cold Brew -- but the current in-store chalkboard menu (Google Photos, recent) shows Americano, Cappuccino, Chai, Latte, Hot Chocolate, Cold Brew, Tonic, Seasonal Latte, Seasonal Soda. No Macchiato, Cortado, Espresso-as-a-drink, or Brew on the current board. The website may be advertising discontinued items and missing current ones (Chai Latte, Tonic).

No prices published anywhere on the website's core 'Menu' page (Coffee/Tea/Steamers) -- confirmed absent across the site itself and every third-party directory checked (Yelp, Restaurant Guru, Restaurantji).

Pricing that DOES exist publicly is scattered across three disconnected, uneven sources: the Summer Menu page (image carousel, seasonal only), Google Photos (a customer-shot chalkboard photo and an owner/customer-shot seasonal paper menu), none of which are structured or guaranteed current.
Site is not mobile-responsive: fixed desktop layout, tiny nav, no sticky/jump navigation, image-only Summer Menu page inaccessible to screen readers and unreadable to search engines.
Hours are inconsistent across the website, Google Business Profile, and the Markets Ontario site -- needs client confirmation.

images.note: Only official Roam-owned, Squarespace-hosted images are included below as production-ready. Google Business Profile photos were reviewed for design inspiration (interior styling, latte art, plating) but are NOT included here as image sources -- most are customer-submitted, not Roam's own content, and Google's hosted URLs are session-scoped and can break. Before final build, ask the client directly for her own high-res originals (especially the espresso-bar/counter shot and the chalkboard/menu-board shot found on GBP) rather than hotlinking.
